payload.text: In the About window the page's own load, at its own address, is followed, and so is a link to a place in the page. A link the user follows to an http, https or mailto address opens in the browser, not in the window, and so does one that would open a window. Every other navigation is cancelled, among them a form, a reload, a refresh, a frame, and a link to a file or to another of the page's addresses. The page's JavaScript is off, and a load that fails is told to the app's log.
